Maya R.: Quick check — embargo lift for Q3 dedicated reservations tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Are reservations reconciled? cc @Arjun S., @Priya K., @Ben L.
Arjun S.: Reconciling now. Vendor manifest missing 3 rack IDs (R-142, R-143, R-144). Asked ops to re-validate ETA.
Priya K.: Inventory: 9/12 nodes provisioned in us-west-2. Two nodes are at 'firmware_pending' and one is 'cable_pending'.
Ben L.: Staging canary passed smoke at 03:12 UTC. No regressions. :thumbsup:
Logan C.: Quick dependency Q — if vendor shipment delayed, what's fallback? burst pool or degrade model size?
Maya R.: Preference: use burst-pool (reserved spare nodes) up to 20% of committed capacity, then route to hosted smaller model variants. If exceeding burst, trigger 'capacity_ripcord' and notify sales. Will post policy snippet.
Maya R.: ```yaml
fallback_policy:
  prefer: burst_pool
  burst_limit_pct: 20
  secondary: hosted_smaller_models
  ripcord_alert: sales_ops
```
deploy-bot: burst-pool status: us-west-2 -> 52 slots available, us-east-1 -> 12 slots available. (checked 1769801200)
Arjun S.: Ops update from vendor: manifest re-send in 45m; ETA to site delivery +2 days. That 3-rack gap becomes 0 on successful resubmission, but timelines shift.
Priya K.: KMS rotation scheduled tomorrow 07:00 UTC for customer keys in the cluster — security flagged potential impact to private deploy onboarding. @Nadia (sec) can you confirm overlap risk?
Nadia (sec): Confirmed — rotation will touch key ring 'dedicated-prod' between 07:00-07:20 UTC. We can shift to 08:30 if it blocks provisioning. Need approval from Maya.
Maya R.: Ok please move rotation to 08:30 UTC. @Ben L. can you hold PR review until after 19:30 PT? (oncall and code review ask)
Ben L.: Yeah oncall til 19:30 PT. Will review PR #3245 after that. :eyes:
Logan C.: I'm going to tag the routing policy change as config flag 'enable_burst_fallback' — will make it default off and flip during lift. @Arjun S. please ensure orchestration playbook references it.
Arjun S.: Will add to playbook. snippet in infra-runbook PR coming 30m.
Priya K.: Note for console: expose 'effective_capacity' metric so SRE can see burst vs committed. Filing ticket: WEB-789.
Maya R.: Thanks all. Action items: Arjun reconcile manifest (0/3 racks outstanding?), Priya confirm node readiness + firmware fix, Ben review PR after oncall, Nadia shift KMS to 08:30, Logan prepare feature flag flip doc, deploy-bot attach burst numbers to the rollout message. I'll send a short status email at 12:00 PT if we hit green.
deploy-bot: Rollout reminder scheduled: 1769840000 (reminder in 3h).
Priya K.: :wave: thanks, will update infra-runbook once firmware clears.
Ben L.: :thumbsup:
